easy_fields.name: C-EVAL
easy_fields.creator: Yuzhen Huang, Yuzhuo Bai, Zhihao Zhu, Junlei Zhang, Jinghan Zhang, Tangjun Su, Junteng Liu, Chuancheng Lv, Yikai Zhang, Jiayi Lei, Yao Fu, Maosong Sun, Junxian He
easy_fields.publisher: 37th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2023) Track on Datasets and Benchmarks
easy_fields.citeAs: Huang, Y., Bai, Y., Zhu, Z., Zhang, J., Zhang, J., Su, T., Liu, J., Lv, C., Zhang, Y., Lei, J., Fu, Y., Sun, M., & He, J. (2023). C-EVAL: A Multi-Level Multi-Discipline Chinese Evaluation Suite for Foundation Models.
easy_fields.description: C-EVAL is the first comprehensive Chinese evaluation suite designed to assess advanced knowledge and reasoning abilities of foundation models in a Chinese context. It comprises multiple-choice questions across four difficulty levels: middle school, high school, college, and professional. The questions span 52 diverse disciplines, ranging from humanities to science and engineering.

G3_collection.reasoning: The paper extensively details the data collection methodology, types of questions, and raw data sources from various Chinese exams and online documents.

G4_annotation.reasoning: The paper describes the manual parsing and annotation by authors, human validation rounds, and the use of GPT-4 for initial explanation generation, followed by manual revision.

G5_rai.reasoning: The paper discusses the intended use cases, acknowledges limitations of the benchmark, and analyzes potential option biases in the dataset.

G6_processing.reasoning: The paper outlines preprocessing steps like parsing, LaTeX conversion, deduplication, and cleaning, and describes the release plan with a private test set and public leaderboard.
